free_tier.stated: Warp Free: "$0/month" with "Warp Agent CLI access", "Bring your own AI inference", "Limited cloud agents access", "Use any harness in the cloud (beta)", quoted; the billing FAQ says "Free uses pay-as-you-go for Warp-provided inference"

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: the free account still grants a CLI and a harness in Warp's cloud, so a key from any inference vendor in this corpus turns Warp into a free agent shell with no seat charge; the cost moves entirely to the endpoint.

limits.value: the free tier includes no Warp-provided inference at all, so a conversation runs only if the client supplies a key, a subscription or a purchase.
